authority.instruction: Reopen and fully extend T11; unblock any scope needed without a further approval gate.

supersession.supersedes_only: The dependency-gated implementation ceiling recorded by the bounded T11 acceptance.
does_not_supersede: T10 evidence dispositions or historical claims
host ownership of identity, tenancy, authoritative persistence, and authoritative XP
the canonical standard-pack release and attribution requirements

claims: T10 accepted seven capability contracts and accepted zero historical runtime contracts.
T10 approved zero of 85 historical asset-adoption mappings.
The bounded T11 delivery intentionally failed closed for responsive, presentation, browser, performance, and QC-host behavior.
This extension does not convert blocked, unknown, synthetic, or absent historical evidence into observed legacy behavior.

decisions: Implement T11 specification phases 2 through 8 as supported forward product behavior.
Use the normative responsive composition specification as the canonical compact/wide product contract.
Define bounded canonical semantic asset mappings when required for the public exemplar, scaffold, presentation components, and QC surface.
Label those mappings as owner-approved product bindings, never as recovered legacy evidence.
Keep cartridges pack-independent and materialize only the selected semantic union from the pinned accepted standard-pack release.
Expose accessible DOM semantics for required non-canvas information and controls.
Fail closed with structured diagnostics for invalid geometry, configuration, asset keys, release bindings, attribution, or unsupported sizes.
Treat browser and performance results as verification evidence only when commands actually run and pass.

deliverables: responsive compact/wide profile resolution and independent input-mode resolution
safe areas, regions, transforms, camera helpers, and state-preserving resize transitions
accessible presentation components and DOM semantics
semantic asset resolver, selected-union materialization, registration, and attribution behavior
reusable gameplay/runtime systems required by the T11 specification
QC controls, diagnostics, performance probes, and browser-test helpers
complete public-API exemplar and non-copying scaffold
